screening_decisions.reason: General review article on enteral feeding complications. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article describing techniques. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review, not a primary RCT.
Retrospective study on timing of EN initiation. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Opinion/critical review article. Not an RCT.
Compares PRG vs PEG, not PEG vs NGT. Non-randomised consecutive patients.
RCT comparing QoL instruments, not feeding methods.
Observational cross-sectional study. No PEG/NGT comparison.
Multicentre RCT with PEG vs NGT arm (321 dysphagic stroke patients). Directly compares interventions in target population.
Prospective observational study of PEG alone. No NGT comparison group.
Review on vitamin D content. Not an RCT comparing feeding methods.
Retrospective comparison of PEG techniques. No NGT group.
Diagnostic accuracy study. No PEG/NGT comparison.
Prospective audit comparing nasal loop vs PEG, not PEG vs NGT.
Quality improvement study. Not an RCT.
RCT on residual volume management thresholds, not PEG vs NGT comparison.
Case series in anorexia nervosa. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective comparison of PEG vs surgical gastrostomy. No NGT group.
Prospective RCT comparing NGT vs PEG (90 patients). Directly addresses protocol question with relevant outcomes.
RCT comparing PEG vs NGT in 40 patients with neurological dysphagia. Primary outcome includes treatment failure aligning with protocol.

This is a cross-sectional study about anemia and nutritional status in hospitalized elderly. It does not compare PEG vs NGT feeding methods, nor does it focus on swallowing disturbances. The study design is observational, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a literature review and case report, not a randomized controlled trial. While it discusses PEG, it does not compare PEG vs NGT in a controlled trial setting.
This is a meta-analysis comparing radiologic, PEG, and surgical gastrostomy methods. It does not compare PEG vs NGT, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a selective literature review about malnutrition in hospitalized patients. It does not compare PEG vs NGT, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a Cochrane systematic review, not a primary randomized controlled trial. While it mentions one RCT comparing PEG vs NG, the review itself is not an RCT.
This is a nonrandomized retrospective study comparing two PEG placement techniques (push vs pull), not PEG vs NGT. It does not meet the intervention comparison criteria.
This is an observational study about dysphagia incidence and diagnosis in stroke patients. It does not compare PEG vs NGT feeding methods, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a case report about surgical treatment of an oesophageal tumour. It is not a randomized controlled trial and does not compare PEG vs NGT.
This is an observational study about nutrition therapy and swallowing rehabilitation. It does not compare PEG vs NGT feeding methods, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a prospective comparison of NG feeding vs oral feeding, not PEG vs NGT. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing the interventions of interest.
This is a retrospective study about swallowing assessment using videofluoroscopy. It does not compare PEG vs NGT feeding methods, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a review article about enteral feeding methods. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing PEG vs NGT.

This is a randomized prospective clinical trial comparing PEG vs NG tube feeding in patients with acute dysphagic stroke. It meets all selection criteria: RCT design, PEG vs NGT comparison, adults with swallowing disturbances requiring nutritional support. Primary outcomes include treatment failure and nutritional status.

This is a randomized trial comparing PEG vs NGT in head and neck cancer patients receiving (chemo)radiation. These patients have swallowing disturbances requiring nutritional support. It meets all selection criteria: RCT design, PEG vs NGT comparison, adults with swallowing disturbances.
This is a randomized trial comparing PEG vs surgical gastrostomy, not PEG vs NGT. The comparison intervention does not match the review protocol.
This is a review article about enteral tube feeding techniques and complications. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing PEG vs NGT.

This is a randomized prospective study comparing PEG vs NGT in patients with acute dysphagic stroke. It meets all selection criteria: RCT design, PEG vs NGT comparison, adults with swallowing disturbances requiring nutritional support. Outcomes include mortality, treatment failure, and nutritional state.

This is a review article about nutrition therapy for children with intestinal failure. It does not focus on adults with swallowing disturbances, does not compare PEG vs NGT, and is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a study about developing a dysphagia assessment scale for Huntington's disease. It does not compare PEG vs NGT feeding methods, and it is not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a Cochrane systematic review about enteral tube feeding in ALS. It is not a primary randomized controlled trial comparing PEG vs NGT.
This study focuses on hospital malnutrition screening and prevalence, not on comparing PEG vs NGT. It is not an RCT and does not address the intervention comparison specified in the protocol.
This is a review article discussing general principles of enteral nutrition delivery methods. It is not an RCT and does not provide primary data comparing PEG vs NGT.

While this is an RCT, it compares operative gastrostomy (OG) vs endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG), not PEG vs nasogastric tube (NGT). The comparison does not match the protocol's specified intervention comparison.
This is a clinical practice guideline document, not an RCT. Guidelines synthesize evidence but do not constitute primary research comparing interventions.
This is a review article aimed at primary care physicians discussing diagnosis and management strategies for dysphagia in stroke patients. It is not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
This is a retrospective review comparing three gastrostomy techniques (FPG, PEG, SEG), not PEG vs NGT. Additionally, it is not an RCT.

This is a Cochrane systematic review that synthesizes data from multiple RCTs. While it includes some RCTs comparing PEG vs NGT, this publication itself is a review, not a primary RCT. The protocol specifies inclusion of RCTs, not systematic reviews.
This is a prospective cohort study, not an RCT. Although it compares NGT vs PEG in older patients, the non-randomized design does not meet the protocol's requirement for randomised controlled trials.
This is a retrospective study comparing patients with PEG vs those without PEG (who received functional therapy only). It is not an RCT and the comparison group does not receive NGT.
This is a population-based registry study assessing survival after various interventions in ALS patients. It is not an RCT and does not specifically compare PEG vs NGT.
This is a methodological paper providing reporting guidelines for RCTs. It is not a primary research study and does not compare any interventions.
This study evaluates organoleptic characteristics of oral nutritional supplements (SON). It does not involve PEG or NGT tubes and is not an RCT comparing feeding methods.
This is a meta-analysis comparing gastric vs post-pyloric feeding routes, not PEG vs NGT. The comparison does not match the protocol's specified interventions.
This is a cross-sectional study examining associations between nutritional parameters and hospital length of stay. It is not an RCT and does not compare PEG vs NGT.
This appears to be a general review article about enteral nutrition principles and practices. It is not an RCT comparing specific interventions.
This is a review article updating information on PEG indications, technique, and nursing care. It is not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
This is a systematic review/meta-analysis comparing gastric vs post-pyloric feeding routes, not PEG vs NGT. The comparison does not match the protocol's specified interventions.
This is a single case report describing PVC-associated dysphagia. It is not an RCT and does not compare PEG vs NGT.
This is a retrospective review comparing PEG vs NGT in head and neck cancer patients. While the comparison matches the protocol, the study design is retrospective, not an RCT.
This is a descriptive analytic study assessing patient/caregiver perspectives on PEG placement. It is not an RCT and does not compare PEG vs NGT.
